paragraphs: R. Yishmael ben Zerud went to visit R. Yannai son of R. Yishmael during his illness; he said, 'Thus said Resh Lakish in R. Ḥiyya's name,' Avodah Zarah, chapter 2 (30a). See R. Shimon ben Zerud.
